$comment: The Node runtime an installed build runs, ruled 2026-11-25: bundle it, do not require the user's. The Rust shell cannot host a JS engine and must not link better-sqlite3, so the sidecar is a stock node.exe shipped as Tauri's externalBin. D8 fetches `artifact`, checks `sha256` against nodejs.org's published SHASUMS256.txt, and fails the build on a mismatch. `test/desktop-guard.test.mjs` asserts this major is one of the majors ci.yml tests on, so the runtime that ships cannot drift from the one the suite measured. Was 20.20.2 until 2026-11-26: Node 20 reached EOL on 2026-03-24, which is the pin-bump trigger DC6 always had.
